help.title: Mind map guide
help.description: This guide explains how to create, edit, open, and export a mind map.

intro.title: Mind maps view
intro.description: This page gathers all project mind maps. Use them to organize visual ideas: characters, plots, places, systems, or relationships.

createPanel.title: Create a map
createPanel.description: This panel opens a blank canvas with a central topic. Give the main node a clear title before saving.

createButton.title: New mind map
createButton.description: Click here to open the editor and start building your map.

existingList.title: Existing maps
existingList.description: Saved maps appear here. They remain available offline when cached or created locally.

cardActions.title: Map actions
cardActions.description: Open the map in read-only mode, edit it, or delete it from these buttons.

help.title: Editor guide
help.description: This guide explains how to use the canvas, organize branches, and save your map.

header.title: Map editing
header.description: The displayed title comes from the central topic. To rename the map, rename the main node before saving.

canvas.title: Interactive canvas
canvas.description: Use the toolbar, context menu, or editor shortcuts to add, rename, move, or delete ideas. Keep nodes short to preserve readability.

nodes.title: Create and organize items
nodes.description: Click a node to select it. Press Tab to create a child item, Enter to create an item at the same level, and F2 to rename the selected item. You can also move items by dragging and dropping them.

relations.title: Add relationships
relations.description: To connect two ideas that are not in the same branch, use Mind Elixir's context menu with a right click on a node, then choose the link option. This is useful for showing a relationship between two characters, a place and an event, or two clues.

shortcuts.title: Useful shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Remove an item with Delete or Backspace. Use the arrow keys to move between nodes, PageUp/PageDown to reorder, Ctrl + plus or Ctrl + minus to zoom, and Ctrl + 0 to reset zoom.

save.title: Save the map
save.description: This button saves the map. Offline changes are stored locally and synced when the connection returns.

help.title: Viewer guide
help.description: This guide shows how to consult and export a mind map.

header.title: Read-only view
header.description: This view lets you consult the map without editing it. To change content, return to the list and use edit.

canvas.title: Displayed map
canvas.description: The map is shown in read-only mode so you can review its structure or present it.

download.title: Export as PNG
download.description: Download the map as an image to include it in a document or share it.

close.title: Close viewer
close.description: This button returns you to the project mind map list.
